templates.why_chosen: Three unlike panels share one figure: an edge-cloud topology (a), two structurally identical but reorder-conflicting five-module NF chains stacked to expose the conflict (b), and a four-pipeline gateway ASIC (c) with 17 flows total.
templates.what_to_learn: Stack two structurally parallel chains directly above each other so a swapped module position jumps out without annotation; but unify panel styles with one shared palette, since packing an edge topology, chain diagrams and an ASIC block diagram with no common visual language is this figure's own listed weakness.
